capabilities: expand triggers into snippets as you type
place the cursor with $0 and reuse regex capture groups
run Obsidian commands after an expansion
configure snippets in a JSONC file in the vault
extras: Installation is via BRAT until the community plugin listing is available. README notes it works entirely offline with no network requests.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to expand short triggers into reusable text automatically while typing.
summary: Text-expansion plugin that replaces typed triggers with snippets on desktop and mobile, using literal or regex triggers, cursor markers, and post-expansion commands.
